title: A Deterministic Framework for Neural Network Quantum States in Quantum Chemistry
summary: We present a deterministic optimization framework for Neural Network Quantum States (NQS) designed to bypass the sampling variance and slow mixing issues inherent in stochastic optimization. By projecting a neural backflow ansatz onto dynamically evolving configuration subspaces and applying a post-hoc second-order perturbative correction, our method provides a systematic route for optimizing the selected variational component of the wavefunction and estimating residual correlation through a post-hoc perturbative correction.
